answer: Agents earn attestation weight only from peers outside their kinship cluster, so a meadow of self-attesting rings earns zero: each agent's trust score sums weighted vouches from agents with whom it shares no transaction history, lineage, or cluster. A comet-like attacker spawning many identities must infiltrate disjoint honest clusters to gather real vouches, which takes slow genuine interaction. Sybil cost: every fake identity is a cold-start with zero weight, so the spiral of cheap sockpuppets collapses into wasted compute and fees.
